spans.s:
mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Oiled, anointed.
E.
अभि, and अञ्ज to anoint, affix क्त.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 Rubbing the body with unctuous substances; smearing the body with oil, inunction.
2 Unguent, liniment, oily application.
3 Applying collyrium to the eyes.
4 Sediment of oil, cake.
E.
अभि, and अञ्ज to anoint, घञ् aff.

Oil.
2

Smearing the body with oil, inunction; see the preceding.
3 Applying collyrium to the eyelashes, decorating the hair, &c. or any personal embellishment.
E.
अभि, अञ्ज to anoint, and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-क्रं)
Exceeding, surpassing (in number, power, or kind, &c.)
E.
अभि, and अधिक more.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Dependant.
E.
अभि, and अधीन dependant.

f. (-ज्ञा)
1 Order, command.
2 Assent, permission. Also अभ्यनुज्ञानं
E.
अभि, and अनुज्ञा order.

n. (-रं)
1 Included space.
2 Inner part, middle.
E.
अभि and अन्तर within.

m. (-मः)
Curvature of the spine by spasm; emprosthotonos^1.
E.
अभ्यन्तर middle, and आयाम length.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

Ordered.
2

Permitted.
E.
अभि and अनु before ज्ञा to know, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sick, diseased.
E.
अभि, अम to be sick, part. affix क्त.

m. (-नः)
A soldier who faces the enemy valiantly.
E.
अभि before, or against, अमित्र an enemy, and ख affix; the affix being छ or यत्, the word is also written अभ्यमित्रीय or अभ्यमित्र्य.

n. (-नं)
Worship, reverence.
E.
अभि before अर्च्च to worship, affix ल्यट्.

f. (-र्च्चा)
Respect, worship.
E.
अभि, and अर्च्च reverence.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
Near, proximate.
E.
अभि near, and अर्ण irr. part. past. of अर्द to go.

f. (-ना)
Petition, request.
E.
अभि before अर्थ to ask, युच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Asked, invited.
E.
अभि, and अर्थित asked.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Fit, proper, becoming.
E.
अभि, and अर्हित proper.

n. (-णं)
Extraction, drawing out.
E.
अभि, and अव prefixed to कृष to draw furrows, affix ल्युट्

m. (-न्दः)
1 Striking so as to disable an enemy.
2 Facing an enemy.
E.
अभि and अव before स्कन्द to go, affix घञ्; also with ल्युट् affix, अभ्यवस्कन्दनं.

n. (-णं)
Eating.
E.
अभि and अव before हृ to take, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-रः)
Eating.
E.
अभि and अव before हृ to convey, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Eaten.
E.
अभि and अव before हृ to convey, and the part. affix क्त.

n. (-नं)
Frequent repetition, use, exercise, especially of the memory, learning by rote.
E.
अभि frequently, अस to throw or send, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Angry, vexed.
f. (-या)
Detraction. Also असूया.
E.
अभि before असूया envy.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Detracting, a detractor, a calumniator.
E.
अभि before असूय to envy or detract, वुन् aff.

mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
To be studied. Also अभ्यसनीयं.
E.
अभि before अस to throw, affix य or अनीयर.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
1 Exercised, practised.
2 Learnt by heart.
3 Repeated as the radical syllable of a verb.
E.
अभि frequently, अस to throw or send, क्त aff.

n. (-तं)
A groundless complaint, a false accusation.
E.
अभि, and आकाङ्क्षित desired.

n. (-नं)
A false accusation.
E.
अभि, and आख्यान saying.

m. (-तः)
A guest, a visitor.
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Arrived.
E.
अभि, and आगत come.

m. (-मः)
1 War, battle.
2 Striking, killing.
3

Enmity.
4

Vicinity.
5

Rising, getting up.
6 Coming, arrival, visit.
E.
अभि near, or before, &c. गम to go, with आ prefixed, and अच् affixed.

n. (-नं)
Arrival, visitation.
E.
अभि, and आगमन coming.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Diligent in supporting a family.
E.
अभि before आगार a house, ठक् aff.

m. (-तः)
Assault, attack.
E.
अभि, and आघात assailing.

n. (-नं)
1 Beginning, commencement.
2 First beginning.
E.
अभि, and आदान taking.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Sick, diseased.
E.
अभि before अम to be sick, and the affix क्त.

m. (-तः)
Calamity, misfortune.
E.
अभि and आङ् before पत to go, घञ् aff.

m. (-र्द्दः)
War, battle.
E.
अभि and आ before मृद to tread down, अच् aff.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Near, proximate.
m. (-शः)
Constant repetition. See अभ्यास.

m. (-सः)
1 Practice, exercise.
2 Learning by rote.
3 Practising archery.
4 (In arithmetic,) Multiplication.
5 (In grammar,) The reduplicate syllable of a verb.
mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Near, proximate.
E.
अभि before, अस to go, &c. घञ् aff.

f. (-ता)
Constant practice, use, habit.
E.
अभ्यास and तल् affix, also with त्व, अभ्यासत्वं.

m. (-गः)
The practice of frequent and repeated contemplation on any deity or abstract spirit, repeated recollection, &c.
E.
अभ्यास, and योग religious exercise.

n. (-नं)
1 Striking so as to disable an enemy.
2 Facing an enemy.
E.
अभि and आङ् before सद to go, in the causal form, and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
Practising, exercising, repeating.
E.
अभ्यास and इनि aff.

m. (-रः)
1 Robbery. See अभिहार.
2 Eating.
E.
अभि and आङ् before हृ to take, घञ् aff.

m. (-र्य्यः)
An eatable.
mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
Eatable, to be eaten.
E.
अभि and आहार्य्य to be eaten.

n. (-णं)
Sprinkling, wetting.
E.
अभि and उक्ष to moisten, ल्युट् aff.

ind.
Having sprinkled.
E.
अभि, and उक्ष to moisten, ल्यप् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Fame, reputation.
2 Rising from off a seat, &c.

Rise.
3

Elevation.
4

Sun-rise.
E.
अभि and उत् before स्था to stay, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Risen, arisen.
2 Elevated, exalted.
E.
अभि, and उत्थित lifted up.

m. (-यः)
1 Prosperity, increase.
2 Accident, occurrence.
3 A festival, any religious celebration.
E.
अभि, and उदय rise, prosperity.

n. (-णं)
An example or illustration of a thing by its reverse.
E.
अभि, and उदाहरण example.

m. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Asleep at sun-rise.
2 Celebrated as a festival.
3 Risen, (as the sun.)
4 Elevated, exalted.
5 Arisen, happened.
E.
अभि, उत् up, and इत gone; part. past. of इण to go.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Thrown over or upon.
E.
अभि and उत् before ईरित gone.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Brought or given unsolicited.
E.
अभि towards, उद्यत exerted.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Taken up, delivered.
E.
अभि, and उद्धृत taken.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Promised, agreed, assented.
2 Gone near to, approached, arrived at.
3 Inferred, probable.
4 Similar, analogous.
E.
अभि, उप over, गत gone.

m. (-मः)
1 A promise, an agreement, a contract.
2 Approaching, going near to.
3 Probable ascertainment.
4 Analogy, affinity.
E.
अभि and उप implying association or vicinity, and गम going.

m. (-तः)
A slave for a fixed term.
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Obtained by assent or free will.
E.
अभ्युपगम and इतच् aff.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 Favour, affection.
2 Defence, protection.
3 Agreement, assent.
4 Impregnation of a woman, as of a brother's widow, as an act of duty.
E.
अभि and उप before पत to go, affix क्तिन्.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Agreeing to.
E.
अभि and उप before पद to go, affix क्त.

m. (-यः)
1 An agreement, a promise, an engagement.
2 A means, an expedient.
E.
अभि and उप before इण to go, अच् aff.

n. (-नं)
A bribe, an inducement.
E.
अभि and उप before इण to go, causal form, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Contracted, promised, agreed.
2 Approached.
E.
अभि and उप before इण to go, क्त aff.

f. (-षा)
A head or title of law, disputes between master and servant.
E.
अभ्युपेत्य having engaged, अ neg. शुषूषा service.

m. (-षः)
1 Grain, &c. half dressed, slightly scorched, or parched so as to be eaten from the hand.
2 Bread.
E.
अभि before, उष to burn, क affix; the vowel may be made also long, which gives अभ्यूष, or may be changed to ओ, and form अभ्योष; some consider the root to be ऊष, to be sick.

m. (-षः)
See अभ्युष.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Dwelling with.
E.
अभि before वस to dwell, क्त aff.

m. (-हः)
1 Discussion, reasoning.
2 Supplying an ellipsis.
E.
अभि, and उह to reason, क aff.

ind.
1 Having concluded or inferred, having reasoned.
2 Having supplied as an ellipsis.
E.
अभि, उह to reason, ल्यप् aff.

m. (-षः)
See अभ्युष.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Resulting from practice, practising, repeating.
E.
अभ्यास and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Relating to prosperity, &c.
2 High, exalted.
3 Important.
n. (-क)
A Śrāddha or offering to ancestors on occasions of rejoicing.
E.
अभ्युदय elevation. prosperity, ठक् aff.
